top_signals.title: U.S. Energy Exports Hit Records as Global Competition Intensifies
top_signals.summary: Rising U.S. oil and gas production and export capacity, along with a shift in global energy trade flows from the war in Iran, helped the United States hit record highs in crude, fuels, and LNG exports this year. In the decade since 2016, when LNG exports began, and crude oil shipments were allowed to go not only in Canada, U.S. energy exports have soared to make America one of the major crude oil exporters and the world’s biggest exporter of LNG, propane, and ethane.     Over the past decade, the U.S. toppled Qatar and Australia…
